title: trifolium purpureum subsp. roussaeanum
intro: Trifolium purpureum subsp. roussaeanum, commonly known as Roussaean red clover, is a subspecies of the perennial herbaceous plant Trifolium purpureum. Roussaean red clover is known for its potential health benefits, including its anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which may help to reduce the risk of chronic diseases such as heart disease and cancer. The therapeutic actions of Roussaean red clover include its ability to stimulate the immune system, improve cardiovascular health, and exhibit antimicrobial properties. The bioactive constituents of Roussaean red clover include isoflavones, saponins, and polyphenolic compounds, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
